title: Border
description: One shape for one polity, one year, and one source set. Geometry is GeoJSON or a geometry_ref. provenance historical-basemaps-gpl is allowed only under borders/gpl/. borders/ccby/ must be fresh-drawn and must not derive from GPL shapes.

year.description: Nominal year of this shape. Must lie inside earliest and latest.

provenance.description: historical-basemaps-gpl is legal only in borders/gpl/. fresh-drawn is required in borders/ccby/.

derived_from_gpl.description: True only for shapes inherited from historical-basemaps. Must be false under borders/ccby/.

fresh_source.description: Required under borders/ccby/. A source id with dataset fresh-drawn and a non-GPL license.

geometry_ref.description: Repository-relative path to one .geojson geometry, Feature, or single-feature FeatureCollection. Must stay inside the same license folder.
